read_contract.description: reference_reads are per child and measured after the untimed preflight. Bounds are carried per case; cancellation accepts 0..1 because the first cancelled child may stop before or after the resolver charge.
read_contract.normalization: elapsed_ns_p50 / repeat is retained as an exact float before cross-sample medians, deltas, and bootstrap intervals.
read_contract.resolver: Main/Data/Archive/Hidden; ordinary vertical tables use A:C, horizontal tables use rows 100:101; metadata controls are zero-read descriptors.; dynamic projected INDIRECT lanes use Main H1="C1" and C1=10

correctness_requirements: preflight compares exact scalar result kind/value or every matrix coordinate for all lookup cases
ADDRESS covers A1 and R1C1 absolute/relative formatting and sheet qualification
CHOOSE and IF preserve lazy branch selection without reading unselected references
MATCH exact lanes use linear scans while sorted approximate MATCH/LOOKUP/HLOOKUP/VLOOKUP lanes expose binary-search scaling
HLOOKUP/VLOOKUP and LOOKUP validate selected-result-only reads in addition to search-vector reads
INDEX/OFFSET/INDIRECT descriptor probes are zero-read; INDEX admits ReferenceList records and consumer probes read only selected cells or requested matrix cells
typed resource, cancellation, shape/refusal, formula-error, output-matrix, and lazy projected lanes are checked before timing
invalid INDIRECT and OFFSET results consumed by ISREF validate exact FALSE rather than propagating a formula error
matched controls retain the existing SUMIFS evaluate and parse-evaluate lanes plus direct/projected ROWS and ISREF metadata controls
projected invariant numeric MATCH may reuse a complete direct search descriptor, while array-valued and nested MUNIT keys remain position-sensitive
manifest is a flat relative-path to SHA256 map and excludes itself; no wrapper object is accepted
projected dynamic INDIRECT descriptors scale linearly: each coordinate reads its H1 text selector and selected C1 result without invariant reuse
notes: Read bounds for approximate search are deliberately per-case. If the frozen contract chooses a different binary probe count, update only the case-matrix read_contract and the generated verifier mapping before capture; do not replace it with a global zero or an unbounded assertion. Dynamic projected INDIRECT lanes intentionally expect 2N reads for N output coordinates.
